resolution: In STMT-DEI-FILIUS-DEFINES-NATURAL-KNOWABILITY-OF-GOD and STMT-DEI-FILIUS-CH2-CHURCH-TEACHES-NATURAL-KNOWABILITY the council's phrase is quoted, not yet read. STMT-NATURAL-REASON-IS-SHARED-REASON takes the shared sense (DEF-NATURAL-REASON-SHARED), supported by ch. 2's contrast with revelation by a supernatural way; STMT-WF-RELIGION-CUT-OFF-FROM-SHARED-REASON uses the same shared sense, so the defeat WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE does not pass between senses. Under the practice-internal sense (DEF-NATURAL-REASON-PRACTICE-INTERNAL) the reading bridge fails and the fideist bundle survives (needsNaturalReasonIsShared); the defeat is therefore exactly as strong as the shared reading of the council text.
